scenes.headline: How a GPU is shaped around agent workloads
scenes.sub: NVIDIA Rubin: each agentic bottleneck gets its own feature.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Millet! Agents don't send one prompt; they plan, call tools and revise over long contexts. Here's how Rubin is built for that.

scenes.text: Rubin isn't one trick. It is a checklist: each bottleneck of agentic inference gets a specific feature of its own.
scenes.say: The idea: Rubin isn't one trick. It's a checklist, and each agentic bottleneck gets its own feature.

steps.say: Two reticle-limited dies, fused into one package over a fast inter-die link. Three hundred and thirty-six billion transistors.
Decode is memory-bound. HBM4 feeds the cores at twenty-two terabytes a second, and two hundred and eighty-eight gigabytes keep the model and KV cache resident.
NVLink six couples it to other GPUs, so one model can spread across a rack.
Agent runs spend their time in long-context attention. Rubin compresses the intermediate scores into a structured two-to-four sparse form.
So softmax and the second attention matrix multiply work on fewer values.

steps.note: faster exponentials, so softmax keeps pace
steps.say: And exponential throughput goes up, because once the matrix math speeds up, softmax becomes the bottleneck.

left.title: Blackwell
left.say: In mixture-of-experts decode, just locating expert weights becomes the cost. Blackwell tracks one memory descriptor per expert.

right.title: Rubin
right.say: Rubin keeps one shared descriptor, and overrides the pointer and stride inline at runtime.

scenes.title: The factory as one power budget

items.say: At rack scale, on-rack energy storage absorbs the sharp power swings of AI work.
And DSX MaxLPS turns that headroom into up to forty percent more GPUs, in the same power budget.

scenes.label: more agentic throughput per watt than Blackwell, NVIDIA claims
scenes.note: a vendor number, on an internal 2T-MoE workload
scenes.say: Put together, NVIDIA claims up to ten times Blackwell's agentic throughput per watt. Their number, on their own workload.

scenes.text: Keeping expensive compute busy is the whole game, and Rubin plays it bottleneck by bottleneck, from attention to power.

recap: Two dies, 288 GB of HBM4, NVLink 6
Sparse attention scores and faster softmax
One expert descriptor; power smoothed into more GPUs
scenes.say: To recap: memory for decode, sparse attention, shared expert descriptors, and power turned into GPUs.
